name: Fabien Guillebot
biography: Fabien Guillebot is a Hardware Security Researcher at Accenture based in Prague, Czech Republic. He specializes in hardware-level security testing with a primary focus on the automotive sector. Fabien's core expertise lies in designing custom hardware for specialized penetration testing and conducting advanced research in microcontroller glitching and fault injection.
